LanguageData.OOPL.AutoTakeChemfuelDesc: This determines whether {PAWN_nameDef} will automatically refuel with chemfuel when {PAWN_possessive} chemfuel is below {MIN}.\n\nAutomatic refueling is currently {ONOFF}.
LanguageData.OOPL.SuperheatingActive: This determines whether {PAWN_nameDef} will use an extra {FIRE} phoenix flames per second to heat up rooms they are in to {TEMP}°C.\n\nSuperheating is currently {ONOFF}.
LanguageData.OOPL.AbilityDisabledNoPhoenixFlames: {0_labelShort} does not have enough phoenix flames.
LanguageData.OOPL.NotEnoughFlames: Not enough phoenix flames to superheat
LanguageData.OOPL.SuperheatingTooltip: Superheating is active, heating up rooms to {TEMP}°C and burning {FIRE} phoenix flames per second.
